parole.significato: post; pillar (long, fairly thick piece of wood or metal used to stabilise something)
parole.testo: From Middle High German [Term?], from Old High German pfost, from Proto-West Germanic *post (“post, pedestal”). Sense 5 is a semantic loan from English post.

parole.significato: a wooden case or box; a cupboard (in general)
parole.testo: From Middle High German schrīn, from Old High German skrīni, skrīn, from Proto-West Germanic *skrīnī (“shrine, chest”). In older German, Schrein meant exclusively a case or box; the sense “sanctuary” is likely influenced by the English word.
